verdict.rationale: Cross-app file and repository access, such as a Files-app provider or document picker, is a fair axis for a mobile developer app, but the evidence never shows GitHub Mobile doing it. The only device-related material covers browsing code, reviewing PRs and Copilot tasks. A community comment notes it 'doesn't really seem to be a git client', pointing users to Working Copy instead.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access and work with files and repositories from other apps' sandboxes on my device
